dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Please, don't look at me like that.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If we'd solved the riddle at the beginning, then the game wouldn't have been much fun now, would it?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This archipelago suits you... and Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't you think so? Summer, islands, ocean... even if it is essentially just an ocean playground. It's perfect for those on the move.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You could spend a wonderful summer here.
